d: Role Description The Planning Engineer will work part time in a remote capacity, collaborating closely with project teams to develop and maintain production and project plans for industrial and energy-related initiatives. Day-to-day responsibilities include preparing and updating schedules, coordinating resources and timelines, and supporting project control activities to ensure milestones, budgets, and quality standards are met. The role involves analyzing process data, identifying bottlenecks, and proposing improvements to production planning and execution, as well as contributing to feasibility studies and reporting. The Planning Engineer will interact with internal and external stakeholders, ensuring clear communication of project status, risks, and actions, and aligning planning activities with sustainability and efficiency objectives.
q: Strong planning and production planning skills, with experience developing and managing schedules for industrial or engineering projects.
Solid analytical skills to interpret technical and operational data, identify trends, and support decision-making.
Effective communication skills for collaborating with multidisciplinary teams and presenting planning outcomes to stakeholders.
Experience in project control, including tracking progress, monitoring risks, and supporting budget and resource management.
Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Engineering or a related technical field.
Familiarity with industrial processes, energy efficiency, or sustainability-focused projects is an advantage.
Proficiency with planning or project management software and strong competencies in spreadsheets and documentation tools.
Ability to work independently in a remote environment, manage multiple tasks, and meet deadlines across different time zones.
